name: researcher-dispatch-real
description: A researcher bot on the real default engine (claude-sdk) takes a dispatch and hands its answer back. Its turn reaches its wmux tools by their real names and settles done only with a result sent; a turn that reached none of them is an error, not done (4.5.0: the researcher called bare tool names and its wake settled done with nothing sent).

args.title: Which npm scripts does the app define?
args.body: Read the repository's package.json (no worker needed: Read or Grep it yourself) and send back, as your result, the names of the npm scripts it defines.
